notes.title: Spooky Update: Shell-ebrate October with the Crablings! 🎃
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians,

The ocean can be scary, its depths filled with monstrous creatures and cryptic noises… But nothing stops Crablings from protecting the Crab God’s realm! To celebrate Halloween and the month of October, discover a new look for the Cave levels and a unique cosmetic for your Crablings unlockable through this month’s big community challenge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/3997e9f0829f6f70145c9347286be7f7c1fc60d8.png
Enjoy this spooky month, and don’t hesitate to share your best Crabling looks for Halloween on Discord or social media by tagging @crabgodgame!

- The Crab God Team -

notes.title: Major Update: Clawmunity Challenges are here!
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians!

Hello Guardians!

Strength in numbers has never been more important in Crab God. Today, we’re excited to introduce  Community Challenges!

These challenges unite all Crab God players towards common goals, offering both in-game rewards and real-world environmental impact. As you work together to achieve these milestones, you’ll unlock special rewards like accessories for your Crablings and contribute to real-life ocean conservation efforts like you can with Stones of Preservation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/b73e98cb6da8699de14cb90d66eb1c6188e39903.gif

We’re introducing two challenge types: regular challenges and “big events.” Big events will feature unique, limited-time Crabling accessories that become available to all participating players once the challenge is completed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/6791b7e509e444b1a073633fbcfa2e13d52240e9.png

The main menu will keep you informed about ongoing and upcoming Community Challenges. From repelling a set number of enemies to growing specific plants, many objectives await. The only question is: are you up for the challenge? 

Here are the first upcoming Community Challenges:

 27/08/2024 - 02/09/2024 - Grow 3,500 Star Coral
 03/09/2024 - 09/09/2024 - Complete 3,600 Ritual Stones
 10/09/2024 - 16/09/2024 - Cultivate 4,500 plants or corals

Full Patch Notes can be found at the end of this Steam News! Prepare your devoted Crablings, as the ocean is full of dangers and mysteries waiting to be unveiled.

Have fun with the new challenges, and don’t forget to share your feedback on Discord or in the Steam Discussions. Stay tuned for more updates!

 Patch Notes (v1.3.5)

📢 Indicates any changes inspired by community feedback.

New:

 Join forces with other players in Community Challenges, where your collective efforts contribute to real-world ocean conservation! Complete objectives together to unlock in-game rewards and trigger contributions. Check the main menu to see the current challenges and start contributing today!
 You can now Garrison your Hunters so that they stand on top of walls that you’ve built, extending their attack range but preventing them from moving when attacking threats.
 There are 2 new blessings that increase damage from traps and increase the health of your walls.


Improved:

 📢 Made it easier to select threats that are near plants and corals.
 Re-balanced the ‘Hurry’ action - it now costs a bit more favour.


Fixed:

 📢 Fixed an issue where threats would sometimes get stuck on the edge of a level when spawning.
 📢 Fixed an issue where Builders would sometimes go beyond walls to attack threats instead of defend behind them.


- The Crab God Team -

notes.title: Major Update: Crabling Customisation has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Guardians!

Our second Major Update is here with a brand new feature: Crablings Customisation! It’s time to give your crablings the accessories that match their personalities with plenty of options from shell color to facial hair!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/a121b012f058390d722eaaca923def23f932e4c8.gif

We’ve included over 40 customisable options for you, some of which include:

 Cowboy Hat
 Flower Crown
 Boomerang
 Cricket Bat
 Water Lily Hat
 Santa Hat
 Hard Hat

And SO MANY MORE!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/dd2bc3808f875e3c6ea51c0dc3febe6c14763b34.gif

Some accessories are Crabling Role specific, while others will be general options for all roles. The customisation panel will be available for you in the shelter menu, in between levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/73054b06d997ef3d6d62ee54853ac246d5398ec0.png

What do you think of this new update? Give your suggestions and ideas for future cosmetics to add in the Steam Discussions or in our Discord and, most importantly, show us your Crablings in their best look from head to claws!

Also included in this update are some fixes and improvements to the base game. You can read the full detailed Patch Notes at the end of this Steam News! Enjoy your new cosmetics and stay tuned for the upcoming news on the game!

- The Crab God Team -

Patch Notes v.1.2.7:

📢 Indicates any changes inspired by community feedback.

Added

 📢 You can now customize your Crablings! At the beginning of every migration and between every level, you can pick accessories, fish buddies, and new colours for your Crablings. There are over 30 accessories to unlock by completing Tide Trials, digging them up in treasure, and growing your underwater ecosystems
 📢 New “Retreat” action. During the night, you can ask Hunter and Builder Crablings to retreat. They will move back to the Sacred Egg for the rest of the night. Hunters and Builders will automatically retreat when they are low on health
 📢 You can now repair traps in exchange for favour, returning them back to maximum charges
 📢 You can now assign Crablings different roles in the shelter between levels
 New “Hurry” action. You can now hurry a Crabling for a small favour cost to speed up what they are currently doing for a short time. Careful though - if you hurry your Crablings too much, they’ll get stressed and fall over!
 There is a control reference guide in the settings menu, explaining all of the control bindings for Xbox, DualSense, and generic gamepad controllers. This control reference guide also appears at the beginning of the tutorial

Improved

 📢 The Needs and Wants of creatures are now shown in the encyclopedia, along with each organism’s name
 📢 Increased the number of save slots from 3 to 4
 📢 Changed the food goal in the last level of a migration so you can't overfill the stockpile
 📢 The pause screen shows when your progress was last saved
 Changed how predators attack threats so they aren’t always attacking, and will circle around before going in for an attack
 Rebalanced the Deadly Tide Trial to increase threat damage but decrease threat health
 You can now select the creature icons on a plant or coral tooltip to view that creature’s needs and wants
 Updated the “Send Feedback” screenshot tool to capture more useful screenshots

Fixed

 📢 Fixed an issue where Crablings would occasionally not attack threats beyond a wall
 📢 Fixed an issue where some SFX could be heard during the shelter when they weren’t meant to
 📢 Fixed an issue where achievements that specified “Level 10” Crablings weren’t firing as expected
 📢 Fixed an issue where finishing a level while time was slowed would keep time slowed until the shelter
 📢 Fixed an issue where some volcanic levels were too dark

notes.title: TactiCon demo + Teasing update
notes.notes:
Hello Guardians!

For TactiCon 2024, Crab God has a free demo to make you discover the aquatic world of the Crab deity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/2d3306745c4b8eb26bad00fbce5f8309e396b144.png
About the demo
Grow your cabling colony by raising crabs, leading the migration, and cultivating a vibrant underwater ecosystem! In this demo, you will be able to:

 Explore the first 2 levels of the game
 Customize your crablings with names, roles and traits
 Encounter various aquatic species
 Cultivate plants and corals to create your own ecosystem

The demo lasts between 30 minutes to 1 hour of gameplay however you may replay as many times as you want to discover new traits, try different strategies and unlock other aquatic species!

Please, note that there will be no Eco Rewards implemented in this demo and that you will be able to keep your progress to the main game to continue your journey after the game's release!

Share your feedback directly in the Steam Discussions! We're impatient to know what you think of the game!

Teasing Next Update

We’re also working on a highly anticipated (and requested) feature for Crab God and would love your opinions on it - Crabling customisation! We’re introducing hats, shell colours and even fishy buddies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/35f7c7aaed72ce6598da541950e3dcd746679288.png

This new cosmetic update will help your Crablings look their best in their finest clawstume, and give you an even deeper bond with your little multi-legged followers.

Note: All of the above mockups are still a work in progress and could change significantly by the time they are released.

We also want YOUR input. If you could add any accessory to the game, what would it be? What are your thoughts on how customisations and accessories will be unlocked? Give us all your crabtastic ideas and thoughts!

– The Crab God Team –

notes.title: Major Update: New game modes are here!
notes.notes:
Hey Guardians!

First, we wanted to thank you all for your support, feedback, and the love you showed to your crablings during this first week of release! So many great things happened in the last few days:

 The Wholesome Games team reposted our trailer
 We had an article in the New York Times
 915 likes on our release trailer post on X
 We are Very Positive on Steam
 We had so much love and support from our indiedev/indiegame community like AggroCrabs, Which Way Up: Galaxy Games, Noble Steed Games, Weyrdlets, Week of Rain, Trese Brothers Games, CaveBear Games, Purring Campfire… and so many of our dear friends! (go check all of their amazing games)
 And of course you, our amazing community who made us laugh with your crab jokes, smile with your feedback and cry with your crablings being sacrificed in the name of the Crab God!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/8de324e02b7b3308ab3d86b044f30afe60fa9ba3.gif

We know you wanted more challenges in the game so, here's the most important part of this update: the arrival of the new game modes: the Tide Trials.
Tide Trials are gameplay modifiers that add extra challenge or silliness to a migration. They can be activated after completing your first migration, and added to each migration from then on! Completing a Tide Trial will earn you shiny new badges and achievements. There are 6 new trials, with more to come over time:

 Permanent Roles Trial: Once a Crabling’s role is selected, it cannot be changed. Adapt or perish!
 Fast Trial: Everything is faster - movement, attacks, favor generation, and food drops.
 Deadly Trial: Crablings' health is halved, while threats become twice as tough.
 Chaos Trial: Traits and blessings are random. Embrace the unpredictability!
 No Eggs Trial: No new Crabling eggs. You start with just 4 Crablings. Role swapping is free.
 Timed Trial: Complete each level in a set number of days or face automatic migration and tough sacrifices.

Will your crablings survive these new hardships? Let us know how your colony fared in the Trials and if you have suggestions for new ones to be added later! To celebrate this amazing post-launch, the 10% discount sale is still happening for one more week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/2cc04752514c18ad8e6a8939c0dbfef958f3ea07.png

We have a lot of plans for the future, and the Tide Trials game modes are just the beginning of new additions to the game! You can read the full patch note details at the end of this Steam News! 

May the Claw be with you for the trials to come!

- The Crab God Team -

notes.title: New release date for Earth Appreciation Fest!
notes.notes:
Happy Earth Appreciation Day, dear Guardians!

On this special occasion we celebrate nature both on the ground and underwater! We are thrilled to be part of the Earth Appreciation Fest on Steam among many games that put nature at the heart of their story. 

And even bigger news, we have an official release date: June 20th! Dive into Crab God's realm with this exclusive gameplay video:

[previewyoutube=muyNGK5NifQ;full][/previewyoutube]
To make you experience your own aquatic journey to the fullest, we could never have found a better muse than nature itself. Our team has always loved coral reef ecosystems. To us, it feels like the perfect setting for a video game filled with weird and wonderful creatures! We had so many options but limited time so we needed to focus. We picked creatures that were beautiful, bizarre, mechanically important, and then just a few of our favourites!

Inspiration for Creatures

Our favorite "bizarre" fishes are the Angler Fish with its glowing light that it uses to attract preys, or the Cleaner wrasse that swims into predator's mouths to clean parasites. The mitten crabs (one of the in-game threats you face) also fall into this list and the name pretty much says it all; they are crabs, with mittens! The butterfly fish and surgeon fish are both striking and beautiful. Easy picks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/58b2d839fa1960678c5b13162c7b5988bb5ad611.png
We also have a fondness for the clownfish (probably the most photogenic fish in the world) and the sea turtle, a fascinating animal that is majestic, ancient, and serene. We just had to put both of them in the game! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/a65ce39087429f6514834b61f0407533961d5dbc.png
And there are also the mechanically important creatures - these are the creatures that make up the base of the ecosystem or serve strategic purposes in the game, essentially for making a fun experience! The giant grouper is a huge (they can grow up to 2.7m or 9 feet) and interesting fish that naturally preys on some of the threats in the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/aba08cd9198b7a92963f47cbb3484eda5ec76e67.png
Inspirations for Corals and plants

Corals are actually animals. What we typically think of as a coral is actually made up of thousands of tiny animals called polyps. A coral polyp is an invertebrate that can be as small as a pinhead or as large as a basketball! When choosing plants and corals, we wanted to ensure there was a diverse range from many different ocean depths, and wanted to ensure that they were visually appealing.

The stalked jellyfish is one of the deep sea corals that we knew we had to include due to its striking alien appearance. We knew that we had to include anemones due to their symbiotic relationship with clownfishes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/a6ac5a11f7aee211e189cbc4676aa44308494f6b.png
Giant kelp is one of the plants you can add to your ecosystem in the game, and it creates stunning forest-like aquascapes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/83cd81126c0d0b86f3bdb4b2a58ad762430ef739.png
In the end, we have always been inspired by the beauty and diversity of the ocean, and Crab God captures a fraction of our incredible underwater world. Enjoy the event on Steam and we will come back with more news in the upcoming days!

- The Crab God team -
